title: Accept an assigned incident and move it to scheduled
description: This verifies that a service provider can accept an assigned work order before the deadline and see it progress to scheduled.

steps.description: Fill in the credentials for a service provider
Verify the incident is shown in a scheduled state
Verify the incident history includes the acceptance update

title: Review an incident list and open a detail view
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can open the incidents area, review available incidents, and access an incident detail with its current status and timeline.

steps.description: Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Open an incident from the list
Verify the incident detail view is displayed
Verify the current incident status and timeline are displayed

title: Resolve an incident with closing details
description: This verifies that a service provider can finish an in-progress incident with closing details and move it to resolved.

steps.description: Fill in the credentials for a service provider
Finish the work with closing details and photos
Verify the incident is shown in a resolved state
Verify the incident history includes the resolution update

title: Follow a service request through accepted status changes
description: This verifies that a service provider can accept an assigned work order and progress it through the expected incident statuses without duplicate consecutive states.

steps.description: Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Update the incident through confirmed arrival, in-progress, and resolved statuses
Verify the incident status history is displayed
Verify duplicate consecutive statuses do not appear

title: Confirm arrival and move an incident to in progress
description: This verifies that a service provider can confirm arrival on an active incident and see it move to in-progress.

steps.description: Fill in the credentials for a service provider
Verify the incident is shown in an in-progress state
Verify the incident history includes the arrival update

title: Show resolved incident closing photo in admin detail view
description: This verifies that an administrator can open a resolved incident and confirm the closing photo renders in the detail view.

steps.description: Fill in the credentials for an administrator
Verify the incident detail is visible
Verify the closing photo is displayed

title: Accept a work order within the deadline

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}

Open a resolved or closed incident
Enter a comment about the service
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the new rating feedback is visible in the incident detail
